title: dryopteris subpubescens
intro: Dryopteris subpubescens, commonly known as the Subpubescent Wood Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis, and its ability to lower blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of D. subpubescens include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms associated with these conditions. The bioactive constituents of D. subpubescens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential in treating various diseases.
